description: Measuring cases every renderer must pass. Each case measures render documents at a width under the conditions given and checks `expect`. `same height`: every measurement gives one height. `same height per document`: measurements of the same document agree. `switch branches`: the named switch shows the named branch. A `document` is inline or a path relative to docs/genui/render. Conditions left out take their default: images `loaded`, theme `light`, nothing pressed or chosen, host `happy_agent`, animation 0, scrolled `start`. Heights are the platform's own; only equality and branches are checked.

cases.name: Loading, loaded and failed images measure the same
Light and dark measure the same
Pressing, choosing and disabling measure the same
The active step's motion and a scrolled carousel measure the same
A figure's height comes from its pixel ratio, not its file or size
A cover's height comes from its shape, not its pixels
Clamped text past its line count measures the same however long it is
